async def act(page):
    # Fill the status textbox with 'Playing Badminton'
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name="What's your status?").fill('Playing Badminton')
    # Look for a save button to save the changes
    try:
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes').click()
    except:
        # If no save button found, assume auto-save or try alternative
        try:
            await page.get_by_role('button', name='Save').click()
        except:
            # If still not found, wait a bit for potential auto-save
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Wait for any save operation to complete
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    return 'Status set to Playing Badminton'
